Definition: Chammon, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Hammon = "warm springs"; 1) a town in Asher, apparently not far from Zidon-rabbah; 2) a town in Naphtali allotted to the Levites; also called 'Hammath' and 'Hammoth-dor'
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
